card.name: Superscripts and exponent digits
card.fires_on: Digits or marks written as superscripts or subscripts right after a unit, symbol or base, such as the 2 in mg 2/dL, the exponent in 10 8, or SM and ® marks.

modes.label: Exponent digits
modes.description: A digit that is a power or subscript attached to a unit, number or letter.

modes.label: Trademark and annotation marks
modes.description: Small raised marks after a name, such as SM, ® or accent symbols.
